title: Peanut Butter Cookies
hookLine: United States-inspired peanut butter cookies with 3 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350ºF (180ºC). In a large bowl, mix together the peanut butter, sugar, and egg. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m52958_1}, {m52958_2}, and {m52958_3} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure peanut butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Scoop out a spoonful of dough and roll it into a ball. Place the cookie balls onto a nonstick baking sheet. For extra decoration and to make them cook more evenly, flatten the cookie balls by pressing a fork down on top of them, then press it down again at a 90º angle to make a criss-cross pattern.

steps.title: Bake Peanut Butter Cookies & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 18 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the bottom of the cookies are golden brown. Remove from baking sheet and cool. Let Peanut Butter Cookies cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 12 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 26 mins!
